sources.title: Riven Build Guide: [26.19] Become A Riven God

passive.name: Runic Blade
passive.text: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.

spells.name: Broken Wings
spells.text: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.

spells.name: Ki Burst
spells.text: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

spells.name: Valor
spells.text: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.

spells.name: Blade of the Exile
spells.text: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.

damage.value: Riven deals ability and basic-attack damage in bursts of strikes, with Runic Blade adding damage to her attacks.

archetype.value: Riven plays as a close-range bruiser who combines strikes, a stun, and damage blocking.

axis.value: Riven can take short trades by striking, stunning nearby enemies, and blocking incoming damage.

winCondition.value: Riven wins by executing combos and outmaneuvering opponents.

spikes.at: When Blade of the Exile is active
spikes.why: Riven gains Attack Damage, range, and one use of Wind Slash.

bait.why: Once Riven spends Ki Burst, she cannot stun nearby enemies with it again until its cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Blind-picking Riven is a mistake because she loses many matchups.
Riven loses Runic Blade's additional basic-attack damage when she uses abilities without following them with basic attacks.
